title: Kent County Council: Using predictive analytics to prevent homelessness in Maidstone and Kent
summary: Kent reports under 1% homelessness among proactively supported households versus 40% in an unsupported comparator. The groups were not randomized.
account: Kent describes Maidstone’s use of an AI-enabled Xantura platform to flag households for proactive homelessness support and a wider county pilot. The council presenter reports that fewer than 1% of supported alerted households became homeless, compared with 40% of a group that lacked support because of limited capacity. The comparison was not randomized and does not separate AI’s effect from the support intervention. Outcome dates are unspecified.
purpose: Identify households at risk of homelessness so that councils can offer proactive support.
system: Xantura AI-enabled predictive-analytics platform used for homelessness prevention
deployer: Maidstone Borough Council and Kent County Council with participating district and borough councils

ratings.reason: The council reports that proactive support prevented homelessness in a high-risk cohort. The groups were not randomized, and AI’s separate effect is unknown.
The reported prevention program improves targeting and preventive results for councils. The source does not supply sample sizes or an independent evaluation.

ai_role.statement: The presenter describes an AI-enabled platform that combines council data and flags households for human support. The prevention comparison concerns the combined targeting-and-support program. Because support was capacity-constrained and not randomized, AI’s separate contribution to the difference is not established.

evidence.citation: Kent County Council video presentation published by the Local Government Association, with an automated transcript. Outcomes are reported by the council and have not been independently evaluated.
